title: Natural prescribed evaluation tensor comparison on complexes
statement: For every prime ℓ, finite coefficient extension E and scheme W, and each n, the prescribed coefficientEvaluationTensorIso on arbitrary pairs of coefficient sequence complexes is the component of a single natural isomorphism from evaluation of their total tensor to the total tensor of their evaluations. There is no K-flat, boundedness or normalized-system hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 07A4 and 0941; ordinary evaluation tensor, totalization and section transport

proof.text: Totalize the natural ordinary evaluation tensor isomorphism using the left adjoint evaluation functor, giving a natural total chain isomorphism. Inverse generator formulas and inverse cancellation determine its forward pure-generator formula. A section transport heterogeneously equal to the identity equals the canonical transport; hence this formula works for any such transport.

Specialize to the actual coefficient sequence and coefficientEvaluationSection. Its defining equality transport is heterogeneously the identity. Apply the unique generator characterization to identify every component with coefficientEvaluationTensorIso.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedEvaluationTensorChain (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ b : coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t+1, t}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) ⋙
        (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
          coefficientTotalTensor.{u, t+1, t} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n),
      ∀ P Q, b.app (P, Q) = coefficientEvaluationTensorIso l E W n P Q
